notes: The explicit marker (loadExplicitActiveSlotID, lines 105-110) is checked first (lines 132-135) and wins outright once it names a slot that still exists in the loaded list -- lastPlayedAt/createdAt are never consulted when this branch succeeds. slot-a's more recent lastPlayedAt (2026-03-01) is a deliberate distractor: a resolver that fell through to the legacy-fallback branch by mistake would wrongly return slot-a instead.
